title: Finch Circle Loyalty Program — Paid-Share Difference for Registrants with Store Value (Merchandise Purchases)
content:
For registry price protection on a Merchandise Purchases unit that carries store value, the paid-share difference of a registrant with an active Finch Circle Loyalty Program membership is worked by tier:

- **Platinum, Diamond or Icon tier, unit carrying store value:** the paid-share difference is the protection difference times the share of the protection base price not covered by store value — the protection base price less the store value, divided by the protection base price.
- **Silver or Gold tier, unit carrying store value:** the paid-share difference is the protection difference less half the store value, never below zero.

Both parts of each condition must hold: the tier on the registrant's active membership, and store value greater than zero on the unit. A registrant who meets neither condition is outside this rule.

## Worked comparison (hypothetical: base price $200.00, protection difference $50.00, store value $20.00)

| Active tier | Working | Paid-share difference |
|---|---|---|
| Platinum, Diamond or Icon | $50.00 times ($200.00 less $20.00) divided by $200.00 | $45.00 |
| Silver or Gold | $50.00 less half of $20.00 | $40.00 |
| Member tier | outside this rule | — |

With no store value on the unit (hypothetical), neither condition holds, whatever the tier.
